current_phase.next_action: Optional upgrade path: swap polling for Reverb + Echo if concurrency outgrows the 10s bell / 5s trip-page poll cadence.

transport_decision.selection_rationale: Polling at 10s for the bell and 5s for the open trip page meets near-realtime needs without adding a Reverb daemon, laravel-echo, or pusher-js. Easy to swap to Reverb later by replacing usePoll calls with Echo channel listeners.
implementation_evidence: resources/js/composables/useTripRealtime.ts uses usePoll(5000, { only: ['trip'] }) and toasts when activity_version advances.

implementation_summary: Phase 01: TripCollaborationEventService records every mutation as a TripActivityEvent and fans out database notifications to every participant except the actor.

Phase 02: Created NotificationController with index/read/read-all routes, shared notifications.unread_count + recent[] via HandleInertiaRequests, and added a NotificationBell dropdown in AppSidebarHeader.
Phase 03: Selected polling fallback. AppSidebarLayout polls notifications every 10s.
Phase 04: useTripRealtime polls the open trip every 5s and toasts when activity_version advances and the actor is not the current user.
Phase 05: Added 7 feature tests covering fan-out, actor exclusion, shared payload shape, mark-read, mark-all, polling cursor, and stranger isolation.
release_notes: No new infrastructure required. Notifications and live updates run on the existing Laravel + Inertia stack via polling.

To upgrade to push later: install laravel/reverb + laravel-echo + pusher-js, add routes/channels.php with private-trips.{tripId} authorized through Trip::visibleTo(), and replace the usePoll calls with Echo.private(...).listen(...).
Notifications are stored in the standard Laravel database notifications table.
Polling cadence: 10s for the bell (all authenticated pages); 5s for an open trip page.

handoff.summary: Live trip collaboration is implemented in polling mode and verified end-to-end. Bell shows unread count, dropdown lists recent items, mark-read works, open trip pages refresh on remote changes with a toast.
next_agent_steps: If realtime upgrade requested, install Reverb + Echo and replace usePoll calls.
If notification surface grows, paginate /notifications instead of capping at 20.
